description: Duplicate Match Reviewer looks through the records in a view or collection - contacts, accounts, leads, donors, members or suppliers - and finds the ones that are probably the same person or organisation. It groups them, gives each group a match score, and lets you compare the records side by side and decide what to do.
features: Friendly messages for set-up mistakes and empty views
